name: acceptance-suite
description: End-to-end acceptance tests generated from specs with playwright-bdd. Created by the kiro-spec-to-e2e workflow; see TRACEABILITY.md.

scripts.lint:features: for d in features/*/; do bash scripts/lint-features.sh "$(basename "$d")" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:ticket: rm -rf .features-gen && bddgen --tags "@$TICKET and not @app-mismatch and not @unreachable and not @needs-test-hook and not @unexplored and not @flagged" && playwright test --retries=0
scripts.test:suite: rm -rf .features-gen && bddgen --tags "not @app-mismatch and not @unreachable and not @needs-test-hook and not @unexplored and not @flagged and not @journey" && playwright test --retries=0
